comment: Upstream reads of uninitialised memory that a ledger entry accounts for. Read by tools/screen-undefined.py; each entry's reproductions are re-screened by --reverify whenever the upstream submodule moves, and verifiedAtUpstreamCommit records the last commit they reproduced on.

defects.summary: search_start returns success from its tail (_regex.c:9199) without writing new_position, declared uninitialised at :11820, when (*SKIP) has moved the slice and a later search inherits the move; :11835 copies it into state->text_pos.

A second MSan origin on ledger 5's path, not a second defect. The bytes come from the LAZY_REPEAT frame data_r (_regex.c:13567, pushed :13583, popped :15792, read at :15806), and they are read only after ledger 5's uninitialised new_position (:11820) has moved the match to a garbage position: on the reproduction, a build with new_position initialised to state->text_pos gives no MSan report at all, this origin included, and answers the port's single match (screened 2026-10-13, and again 2026-10-18 on upstream 0e8cb05). 'data_r2261' is clang's name for the local and changes with the compiler and the source: it was 'data_r2368' until 2026.9.29's stdbool/stdint renames, which moved no line cited here.
